rounds.prompt: How many standard sticky notes, 3 in (76 mm) square, would it take to cover the Mona Lisa?
rounds.source: Louvre catalogue entry for the Mona Lisa (oil on poplar, 77 x 53 cm) and 3M's standard Post-it sheet, 3 x 3 in (76 x 76 mm)

rounds.prompt: How many grapes does it take to make one 750 ml (25.4 oz) bottle of champagne?
rounds.source: Comité Champagne appellation press yield of 102 litres of must per 160 kg of grapes, published by the Union des Maisons de Champagne, with an average Champagne berry weight of 1 to 1.2 grams

rounds.prompt: How many Olympic gold medals has South Korea won all-time?
rounds.source: All-time Olympic medal tables for South Korea (109 Summer golds through Paris 2024, 36 Winter golds through Milan Cortina 2026)
